column1: # Third-party components a UI package bundles inside itself, whose own licence text must ship beside the
# package's (scripts/third-party-notices.sh copies it, scripts/check-ui-licenses.sh requires it).
# Tab-separated: package, licence file inside the package, component, version, licence expression (allowlisted, or
# scoped to that package in licenses/ALLOWED-LICENSES.txt). The file column is one of:
#   <path>              the component's licence file, shipped as texts/npm/<package>/<component>-LICENSE;
#   <path>:<from>-<to>  a notice in a source file's header lines, shipped as texts/npm/<package>/<component>-NOTICE;
#   -                   no text in the package: the licence's canonical text (texts/common/<id>.txt) is the text.
# xtscancodes: keycodemapdb licenses keymap-gen output "GPL-2.0-or-later OR BSD-3-Clause"; BSD-3-Clause is elected

column4: 1.7.0, core/input/xtscancodes.js, generated by keycodemapdb, BSD-3-Clause elected from its dual licence
